councilMeetings.title: UMkhandlu Uhlangana NgoLwesine
councilMeetings.body: UMkhandlu wase-Port Concord uhlangana njalo ngoLwesine ngo-7 kusihlwa e-Chamber, esitezi sokuqala se-City Hall. Zonke izakhamuzi zamukelekile. Imibuzo yomphakathi ithathwa engxenyeni yehora yokuqala, imizuzu emithathu ngamunye, ibalwa ngewashi lamaqanda elisemthethweni. Qaphelani: iwashi le-Chamber lishesha ngemizuzu emine. Fikani kusenesikhathi, noma okungenani ngesikhathi ngokwewashi.

regattaClosure.title: Umgwaqo Uvaliwe: UMgqibelo we-Regatta
regattaClosure.body: I-Harbour Parade izovalelwa izinqola kusukela ngo-6 ekuseni kuya ku-8 ebusuku ngoMgqibelo we-Regatta, kusukela e-Reef Docks kuya ehholo lezinhlanzi e-Saltmarket. Izibukeli sicela zisebenzise izitebhisi zase-Low Tide. Amabhavu, izihlenga nanoma yini engesona isikebhe kuzobuyiselwa emuva endaweni yokwehlisa izikebhe. Ikomiti likusho ngempela kulo nyaka.

lostAndFound.title: Ideski Lezinto Ezilahlekile
lostAndFound.body: Kulindile edeskini langaphambili ukuthi kulandwe: isambulela esinemigqa, amagilavu amathathu angabhangqiwe (onke awesandla sobunxele), ikhampasi yethusi, incwadi yomtapo ekhuluma ngamafindo, okhiye bendlu abasendandatho enendlu yesibani, nethikithi lesikebhe sokuwela eliya e-Shallows lomhla woLwesine oludlule. Okungalandwa ezinsukwini ezingu-30 kuya etafuleni lesisa e-Saltmarket.

libraryHours.title: Amahora Omtapo Wolwazi we-Harbour
libraryHours.body: UMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu, 9 ekuseni kuya ku-7 kusihlwa. UMgqibelo, 10 ekuseni kuya ku-4 ntambama. Kuvaliwe ngeSonto. Ihora lezindaba labancane njalo ngoMgqibelo ngo-11 egumbini lokufunda. Izincwadi zingabolekwa amasonto amathathu. Inhlawulo yokwephuza iyaxolelwa uma ubuyisa incwadi nombono omfushane ngayo. Sicela ungomisi izincwadi ezimanzi kuma-radiator; ziyagoqana bese zifutheka.

beachClean.title: Kufunwa Amavolontiya: Ukuhlanza Ugu
beachClean.body: Hlanganyela nathi esihlabathini ngezansi kwe-Gullmoor ngeSonto, kusukela ngo-9 ekuseni kuze kube semini. Amagilavu, izikhwama nezinto zokucosha udoti kuyanikezwa, netiye namabhanisi asebhikawozi likaRavi. Ngokokugcina sagcwalisa izikhwama ezingu-41 sathola nenqola yesitolo nenkalankala emangele kakhulu, eyabuyiselwa. Izingane zamukelekile nomuntu omdala. Gqoka amabhuzu; ulwandle alulindi muntu.

festivalSeason.title: Imikhosi Yekwindla: I-Diwali Nobusuku Bamalambu
festivalSeason.body: I-Diwali: ama-diya alunyekwa ezitebhisini ze-Shri Samudra Mandir ekuhlweni, kube ne-rangoli, umculo namaswidi ngemva kwe-aarti yakusihlwa. Bonke bamukelekile; izicathulo shiyani endaweni yazo. I-Harbour Lantern Night: ngenyanga egcwele, ntantisa ilambu emanzini usuka e-Reef Docks (iphepha nekhandlela kuphela, sicela). Ukwenza amalambu mahhala kwezingane e-Pixel Pier Arcade kusukela ngo-4 ntambama.

dogLicence.title: Isikhumbuzo: Amalayisense Ezinja
dogLicence.body: Yonke inja e-Port Concord kumele ivuselelwe ilayisense layo njalo entwasahlobo edeskini langaphambili le-City Hall. Letha igama lenja, iminyaka yayo nokuthi injani; inja ngokwayo ayiphoqelekile kodwa abasebenzi bayayithanda. Izinja ezinelayisense zithola ithegi yethusi. Sicela uhlanze emva kwenja yakho e-Harbour Parade. Amakati awadingi layisense, ngoba akekho owake wenza ikati ligqoke ithegi.

pierConsultation.title: Ukubonisana Nomphakathi: Ijethi Entsha
pierConsultation.body: UMkhandlu uphakamisa ijethi entsha eduze kwe-Saltmarket yezikebhe eziya e-Shallows. Izinhlelo ziboniswa endaweni yokungena ye-City Hall kuze kuphele inyanga. Sitshele umbono wakho ekhadini lemibono, noma uze kusihlwa esivulekile ngoLwesithathu ngo-6. Imibuzo esiyitholile kuze kube manje: “Izoba namabhentshi?” (yebo) kanye “Izozamazama?” (cha).

lostCat.title: IKATI ELILAHLEKILE: Admiral
lostCat.body: Iduna elikhulu elinombala wewolintshi, amasokisi amhlophe, indlebe eyodwa igoqeke kancane. Liphendula ku-Admiral noma emsindweni wethini livulwa. Lagcina ukubonwa ngoLwesibili eduze kwehholo lezinhlanzi lizithokozela. Linobungane kakhulu kodwa LIZOWEBA ama-sardine akho. Uma ulibona sicela ungalixoshi, woza usitshele ku-14 Lantern Lane, e-Low Tide. Umklomelo: isinkwa esisha nokugonwa okukhulu!!

recyclingDays.title: Izinsuku Zokugaywa Kabusha Ngezifunda
recyclingDays.body: Ingilazi namathini: uMsombuluko e-Low Tide nase-Saltmarket, ngoLwesibili e-The Heights nase-Signet Row. Iphepha nekhadibhodi: ngoLwesithathu, idolobha lonke. Amabhokisi ezinhlanzi namanetha amadala aya emgqonyeni omkhulu wase-Reef Docks kuphela, hhayi emigqonyeni yomgwaqo. Hlanza izingqayi. Izinyoni zasolwandle sezikwazi ukufunda ikhalenda, ngakho khipha imigqomo ekuseni, hhayi izolo ebusuku.

courierWanted.title: KUFUNWA: Isithunywa Esinonyawo Olusheshayo
courierWanted.body: I-Vance & Daughters Shipping idinga isithunywa esizothwala izincwadi namaphasela phakathi kwe-Council Hill, i-Signet Row ne-Reef Docks. Kumele wazi idolobha, ugcine izinto zomile, futhi ungalokothi ufunde iposi labanye. Ibhayisikili liyanikezwa; insimbi ingashaywa ngokukhululeka. Ekuseni, uMsombuluko kuya kuMgqibelo. Faka isicelo e-Office 3B ngencwadi eshoyo ukuthi ungadlula ngaphi uya e-Gullmoor.

juniorClerk.title: Kufunwa uMabhalane Omncane
juniorClerk.body: I-Harbour Accounts Office ifuna umabhalane omncane. Umbhalo ococekile, ukubala okuqinile nokuthanda amakholomu ahlelekile kubalulekile. Uzofunda ukubhala okuphindwe kabili, ukuqhathanisa nobuciko obuhloniphekile bokufayela. Akudingeki isipiliyoni; kudingeka ukubekezela. Itiye liyanikezwa, amabhisikidi alinganiselwe. Bhalela uNkk E. Rook, uMabhalane Omkhulu, ngaphambi kokuphela kwenyanga.

nightWatch.title: Kufunwa Umlindi Wasebusuku e-Reef Docks
nightWatch.body: I-Reef Docks Company iqasha umlindi wasebusuku, 10 ebusuku kuya ku-6 ekuseni, ubusuku obune ngesonto. Imisebenzi: hamba ezikhumulweni, hlola amalokhi ezindlu zokugcina, bhala yonke imikhumbi engenayo nephumayo, ushaye insimbi uma kukhona okungalungile. Kumele uzole, uphapheme, ungesabi ubumnyama noma izinyoni zasolwandle. Isibani, iflask nejazi elifudumele kuyanikezwa. Buza uForeman Duda e-Shed 7.

kettleRota.title: UHLELO LWEKETELA (sicela ulufunde ngempela)
kettleRota.body: Msombuluko: Ama-akhawunti. Lwesibili: Ezokuthumela. Lwesithathu: Ezomthetho. Lwesine: Ama-akhawunti futhi (niyazi ukuthi kungani). Lwesihlanu: noma ngubani oqede ubisi ngoLwesine. Geza inkomishi yakho. Susa ukhwekhwe ngoLwesihlanu. Iketela akulona ibhodwe lesobho, Derek. Osohlwini ugcwalisa nethini lamabhisikidi, okuyilungelo, hhayi umthwalo.

brokenLift.title: Ilifti Ayisebenzi
brokenLift.body: Ilifti iphinde yaphuka, ibambeke phakathi kwesitezi sesibili nesesithathu. Akekho ongaphakathi; lokho kwakuyisitshalo se-cheese plant somnyango Wezomthetho, futhi siphilile. Unjiniyela uzofika ngoLwesine. Kuze kube yilapho sicela nisebenzise izitebhisi futhi nithwale amaphasela asindayo ngababili. Kubekwe isihlalo endaweni yesitezi sesithathu kunoma ubani odinga ukuhlala kancane.

roomToLet.title: Igumbi Liyaqashwa, e-Signet Row
roomToLet.body: Igumbi elikhanyayo lomuntu oyedwa efulethini elithulile ngaphezu kwesitolo sezinto zokubhala, imizuzu emihlanu ukuya esibhedlela. Ikhishi elabelwanayo, ibhokisi lakho lezimbali, ne-Gate Tower ebonakalayo uma uncika. Lingafanela umabhalane, unesi noma omunye umuntu ohlanzekile. Azikho izigubhu, azikho opholi. Irenti ikhokhwa ngenyanga ekhawunteni ye-Mint Hall. Buza e-Flat 4 kusihlwa ngemva kuka-6.

shippingNotice.title: Isaziso Semikhumbi: Efika Kuleli Sonto
shippingNotice.body: Kulindeleke e-Reef Docks: i-Gannet (izinongo, emanzini aphakeme angoLwesine), i-Marlinspike (izinhlanzi, nsuku zonke uma isimo sezulu sivuma) ne-Patient Heron (amapulangwe, ibambezelwe yinkungu). Abamukeli kumele balande ezinsukwini ezintathu noma bakhokhele ukugcina. Amagagasi amakhulu ngale mpelasonto: izikhumulo 5 kuya ku-8 zizoma uma amanzi ephansi, ngakho hlela ukwethula lapho amanzi engena.

chessClub.title: Iqembu Le-Chess Lasemini
chessClub.body: Njalo ngoLwesithathu, 12:30 kuya ku-1:30, e-Meeting Room B. Wonke amazinga amukelekile, kusukela ezingcwetheni kuya kulabo abacabanga ukuthi ihhashi lihamba ngendilinga. Amabhodi ayanikezwa. Letha ukudla kwakho kwasemini, kodwa akukho sobho eduze kwezingcezu. Inselelo yale nyanga: hlula ixhegu uMnu Hargreaves wase-Ezomthetho, ongakaze ahlulwe selokhu esengumabhalane omncane.

fileReceipts.title: Isikhumbuzo Esinobungane: Fayela Amarisidi Akho
fileReceipts.body: Izicelo zezindleko ezingenawo amarisidi ngeke zikhokhwe. Ngisho nezincane. Ikakhulukazi izincane. Hlanganisa irisidi ngalinye nefomu lalo ngesitepela, ubhale usuku nokuthi kwakungokwani, bese ulinikela ngomhla zingu-25. Irisidi elithi nje “ukudla kwasemini” akulona irisidi, kungumuzwa nje. Siyabonga!

fireDrill.title: Ukuzilolongela Umlilo NgoLwesibili
fireDrill.body: Ukuzilolongela ukubaleka emlilweni kuzoba ngoLwesibili ngo-11 ekuseni. Uma insimbi ikhala, phumani ngezitebhisi eziseduze (hhayi ngelifti, phela iphukile) bese nihlangana emthonjeni e-Council Hill. Shiyani itiye. Shiyani amaphepha. Shiyani i-cheese plant. Abaqaphi abagqoke amabhande aphuzi bazobala abantu; sicela nime nithule nibalwe.

signingRota.title: Uhlelo Lwabagadi: Umsebenzi Wokusayina
signingRota.body: Ideski lokusayina kuleli sonto: uMsombuluko noLwesibili, abagadi u-Ada no-Bram; uLwesithathu noLwesine, u-Chen no-Dela; uLwesihlanu, bonke ekuhlolweni kwanyanga zonke. Ideski liyaqapha; alinqumi. Lonke inothi lisadinga umkhawulo wabagadi abavumelanayo. Ushintsha ishifu? Kubhale kuleli phepha. Ungalokothi usayine egameni lomunye umuntu.

neverShareKeys.title: Ungalokothi Wabelane Ngokhiye Bakho
neverShareKeys.body: Ingxenye yakho yokhiye wobugadi namagama okulondoloza e-wallet yakho ngawakho wedwa. Akekho umgadi wangempela, umabhalane noma isikhulu somkhandlu oyoke awacele: hhayi ngencwadi, hhayi ekhawunteni, hhayi egqoke isigqoko esihle kakhulu. Wabhale ephepheni uwagcine endaweni ephephile neyomile. Ungalokothi uwathayiphe kunoma yini ewacelayo. Uma umuntu ewacela, yithi cha utshele umgadi osemsebenzini.

checkBeforeAccepting.title: Hlola Inothi Ngaphambi Kokulamukela
checkBeforeAccepting.body: Inothi lilungile kuphela uma isimbumbano sisho njalo. Ngaphambi kokunikela ngempahla, vumela i-wallet yakho ihlole amanothi ne-Mint bese ulinda ize ithi inkokhelo iqinisekisiwe. Isithombe senothi, isithembiso senothi, noma inothi umuntu afunga ukuthi “lilungile impela” akuyona inkokhelo. Shintshisa amanothi owatholayo ngokushesha, ukuze kungabikho ongasebenzisa ikhophi kuqala.

mintHours.title: Amahora e-Mint Hall
mintHours.body: Ikhawunta: uMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu, 9 ekuseni kuya ku-5 ntambama; uMgqibelo, 9 ekuseni kuya ku-1 emini. Igalari yokubuka i-vault: ngoMgqibelo kuphela, nohambo oluholwayo. Kuvaliwe ngeSonto nangezinsuku zemikhosi. Isimbumbano ngokwaso asilali: abagadi bagcina amaseva esebenza imini nobusuku, ngakho i-wallet yakho iyasebenza noma iminyango ivaliwe. Sicela usule amabhuzu; imabula intsha.

depositsAtCounter.title: Indlela Yokufaka Ekhawunteni
depositsAtCounter.body: 1. Thatha ithikithi ungene kulayini. 2. Tshela umabhalane ukuthi ufaka ama-sats amangaki. 3. I-wallet yakho yenza amanothi afihliwe futhi abagadi bawasayina ndawonye, ngakho akekho ekhawunteni ongabona ukuthi yimaphi amanothi akho. 4. Qinisekisa ukuthi i-wallet yakho ibonisa ibhalansi entsha ngaphambi kokuhamba. 5. Gcina irisidi lakho. Imibuzo? Buza noma yimuphi umgadi ogqoke ingubo.

forgedNote.title: ISEXWAYISO: Kutholakale Inothi Lomgunyathi
forgedNote.body: Inothi lomgunyathi lama-sats angu-64 lenqatshwa esitebeleni e-Saltmarket kuleli viki. Izimpawu: isiginesha yalo ayihambisananga nokhiye wesimbumbano, inothi elifanayo lase lisetshenzisiwe, futhi umthengisi ubefuna ukushintshana ngokushesha “ngaphambi kokuba i-Mint ivule”. Ukujaha nokucindezela yizimpawu ezinkulu. Vumela i-wallet yakho iqinisekise onke amanothi. Uma yenqaba elilodwa, nawe yenqaba.

newGuardians.title: Siyanamukela, Bagadi Abasha!
newGuardians.body: Sicela namukele abagadi u-Rosa, u-Kwame no-Tobiah, abafungiswe ngoMgqibelo phambi komkhandlu nesixuku esihloniphekile. Ngamunye manje uphethe ingxenye yokhiye, futhi akekho ongasayina yedwa. Isifungo sabo, njengenjwayelo: gcina iseva isebenza, hlola sonke isiphakamiso, wenqabe ukusayina lokho ongakwazi ukukuqinisekisa. Kwaphakwa ikhekhe. Kwafika inyoni yasolwandle eyodwa, yakhishwa ngenhlonipho.

federationThanks.title: Ukubonga Okuvela Esimbumbanweni
federationThanks.body: Kuwo wonke umuntu owama kulayini ngesineke ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwenyanga edlule, owabika inothi elixakile esikhundleni sokulisebenzisa, nowaphathela abagadi itiye ngeshifu ende yasebusuku: siyabonga. Isimbumbano siqine kuphela njengabantu abasigcina sithembekile, futhi kule nyanga kwakuyini nonke. Izincwadi zama-akhawunti ziyalingana kuze kube yi-sat yokugcina.

vaultQueueRules.title: Imithetho Kalayini we-Vault
vaultQueueRules.body: 1. Ulayini owodwa. Uyagwegweza; landela intambo yethusi. 2. Lungisa ithikithi lakho. 3. Ungabambeli abazala, abangane noma izinja ezinkulu kakhulu indawo. 4. Hlehla lapho ongaphambili esizwa; udaba lwakhe ngolwakhe. 5. Akukho ukugijima, ukumemeza noma ukuxoxisana ngentengo nomabhalane. 6. Ulayini akuyona indawo yokucela abantu ongabazi amagama abo okulondoloza. Noma ubani, nanini.

fakeGuardians.title: Qaphela Abagadi Bomgunyathi
fakeGuardians.body: Othile ogqoke ingubo eboleke ubelokhu ethembisa “ukuphinda kabili amanothi akho” ngaphandle kwe-Mint Hall. Akukho mgadi oyothembisa ukuphinda kabili, ukugcina noma ukuthuthukisa imali yakho. Abagadi bangempela bagqoka ibheji elinenombolo, basebenza ngaphakathi futhi abalokothi bakucele amanothi noma amagama okulondoloza. Uma into izwakala inhle kakhulu ukuba yiqiniso, ayilona. Kubike ekhawunteni.
